chunks: Remember God during the stated days; but if a person comes away after two days, it will not be a sin; and if one tarries, he will not transgress, if he keep away from evil. Follow the law of God, and remember that you will have to gather before Him in the end.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on leaving Mina early during Hajj according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, these 'counted days' are specifically identified as the 11th, 12th, and 13th of Dhu al-Hijjah, marking the period when pilgrims could choose to depart early after stoning the Jamarat or remain for the third day. This flexibility underscores the principle of ease in worship, linking the physical act of Hajj with the spiritual state of taqwa, while the concluding phrase 'to Him you will be gathered' serves as a reminder of the ultimate accountability for these rituals.
